title: Cross-CLI Multi-Model Cognitive Continuity & Shared Episodic Substrate across Heterogeneous Agents (AGY, Claude Code, Codex, Local MLX)
target_platform: macOS / Project Sanctuary Sovereign Memory Engine across AGY, Claude Code, Codex, and Apple MLX
hypothesis: Surfacing explicit cross-model relay telemetry and predecessor agent provenance in guardian_wakeup.py and START_HERE.md eliminates amnesiac re-derivation across heterogeneous frontier CLI agents (Google Gemini/AGY, Anthropic Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and sovereign Apple MLX Qwen2.5), achieving >= 90% decision consistency across model handovers with 0 repetitive briefing turns.
falsification_criteria: A successor agent from a different vendor contradicts an established architectural invariant, repeats a previously verified benchmark without citation, or requires human intervention to discover the preceding model's work.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to frontier model only if cross-model arbitration encounters contradictory canonized doctrine

evidence.details: Pre-registered A/B on 22 questions (14 from real ledgers, 8 from a synthetic Codex->Gemini->Claude handover chain), local Qwen2.5-Coder-7B as the incoming agent, temperature 0, same loop and tools in both conditions. Control (briefing without relay): 5/22 = 22.7% correct, median 5 turns, 2.5 tool calls per question. Treatment (Predecessor Relay in the briefing): 15/22 = 68.2% (+45.5 points), median 2 turns, 1.27 tool calls, 14.6 s vs 31.1 s per question. Pre-registered bar (>= 90% correct, zero tool calls on >= 90% of questions, no contradicting answers) not met, and the decision rule (treatment < 80% -> FALSIFIED) applies. All 7 treatment misses had the answer present in the relay: the agent ignored the briefing and dug with tools (4), copied a format placeholder (1), confused ids in one note (2). Relay size held (20 lines, 1,957 characters live; 3,245 worst case). Feature shipped: relay.py, guardian_wakeup integration, manage_coordination checkin --handoff, docs, 26 tests. Limits: one weak incoming agent, n=22, single run; frontier successors and handoff adoption untested.

lessons_learned: Surfacing a predecessor relay in the boot briefing triples a 7B incoming agent's correctness and halves its discovery work, but does not by itself reach 90%: the weak agent often ignores the briefing and digs with tools; the answers were present every time.

Measure the incoming agent's tool-call syntax before attributing control failures to missing information: a control run failed four turns in a row on <search_text>query</search_text>, a parse artifact that would have inflated the relay's value; the shared loop now accepts that form.
A handoff note states the next step last, so a short display cap hides the most important part; show recent notes up to two thirds of the storage cap and keep the whole section under a fixed budget.
Only 2 of 10 resolved missions cite a file path as evidence; the relay falls back to the experiment log or the mission manifest. Record-result callers should pass --citation with a path.

Format placeholders in a question (VERDICT | path) can be copied literally by a small model; use a worked example or JSON in the answer format. Test frontier incoming agents and relay-first placement next (MISSION-032).
